manualSections.title: Start
manualSections.intro: Everything you need to use your clipboard history every day.

cards.title: Open your history in a flash
cards.body: Press Super + V (customizable in Shortcuts) or left-click the Mklipper icon in your system tray to see everything you copied.

cards.title: Paste in one tap
cards.body: Click any item, press Enter, or press keys 1–0 to paste straight into the window you were working in.

cards.title: Paste without formatting
cards.body: Turn on the Paste without formatting toggle at the top of the popup to strip HTML colors, fonts, and styles when pasting text. Images and files are unaffected.

cards.title: Quick tray menu
cards.body: Right-click the tray icon anytime to edit the latest item, generate a QR code, clear history, or open Settings.

manualSections.title: Cards
manualSections.intro: Search, pin favorites, and make the most of every item's quick actions.

cards.title: Instant search
cards.body: Start typing as soon as Mklipper opens to filter by text, source app, window title, or web URL.

cards.title: Pin what matters
cards.body: Click the star on any card to keep it at the top and protect it when clearing history. The star button in the top bar filters to pinned items only.

cards.title: Edit text or create a QR code
cards.body: Hover a card to edit text inline before pasting (Ctrl + Enter saves), generate a scannable QR code for your phone, or reopen the original link.

cards.title: Remove items cleanly
cards.body: Click the trash button or press Del on the selected row to remove an item right away.

manualSections.title: Actions
manualSections.intro: Automate quick tasks on what you copy, like opening links or transforming text.

cards.title: One-click links & files
cards.body: When you copy a web link (https://...) or a local file path, a lightning bolt button appears on the card to open it with your default app.

cards.title: Optional automatic menu
cards.body: If you want the actions menu to pop up automatically whenever you copy a matching link or rule, turn on Automatic actions menu in the tray menu or Settings.

cards.title: Custom rules (power users)
cards.body: In Settings → Actions you can define regular-expression rules that run commands using %s for the copied text and optionally replace the clipboard with the output.

manualSections.title: Shortcuts
manualSections.intro: Control everything from your keyboard with full support for standard and gaming keyboards.

cards.title: Global shortcuts synced with Cinnamon
cards.body: In Settings → Shortcuts you can assign keys to open history, toggle Paste without formatting, edit the current item, show its QR code, cycle history, or clear it.

cards.title: Prefer typing numbers into search?
cards.body: Turn off Use keys 1–0 to quick-paste in Settings → Shortcuts so numbers you type go straight into the search box.

cards.title: Gaming keyboards & manual key picker
cards.body: Mklipper supports macro keys (F13–F24) and any modifier layout. If your OS or keyboard intercepts Super, Ctrl, or Alt while recording, click the keyboard button next to the field to pick keys manually.

manualSections.title: Privacy
manualSections.intro: Your clipboard stays private, integrated with Linux Mint, and leaves no disk leftovers.

cards.title: Password protection
cards.body: Secrets copied from compatible password managers (KeePassXC, Bitwarden, 1Password, etc.) are detected automatically and never saved to history.

cards.title: Clean, zero-residue deletion
cards.body: Deleted items are immediately zeroed out and reclaimed from disk (no database bloat or orphan files), with private owner-only file permissions.

cards.title: Native Linux Mint updates
cards.body: Mklipper integrates directly with Linux Mint Update Manager so updates arrive alongside your system packages, plus optional in-app notifications.
